data.severity: medium; 14 of 18 applicable scenarios have complete evidence, with four explicit coverage gaps
data.impact_scope: Potentially affects users relying on full layered-configuration combinations, less common enum and unsupported-option cases, Linux/WSL paths, and copy-based installation. The current report records Windows local loopback mock evidence.
data.estimated_repair_time: Approximately 0.5-1 working day for S08, S09, and S14 automated scenarios; S15 timing depends on cross-platform environment availability and is unknown.
data.delivery_impact: May proceed to independent Reviewer with gaps recorded. Supplement S15 before release if Linux/WSL or copy-based installation is in the release scope.
data.rationale: The event-bound Tester report records 21 of 21 behavior tests passed and zero failures. It newly covers malformed TOML error behavior, invalid-value fallback, unknown-key ignoring, and the TOML table-header comment regression. These address the user's clarified configuration expectations. Four other acceptance scenarios remain incomplete and should stay visible as risk.
data.residual_risk: Full configuration precedence combinations, every enum and unsupported option, Linux/WSL paths, copy/no-overwrite behavior, branch coverage, real API behavior, and translation quality remain unverified.
data.uncertainty: No commands were run and coverage was not independently recalculated. The release platform scope and availability of cross-platform installation environments are unspecified.
